adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` reads the old `site_settings` value and does `records = val.split("\n")` then inserts each `h` directly via raw SQL (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) without running the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` normalization (`sub!(/^https?:\/\//,'')` and `sub!(/\/.*$/,'')`). The diff also shows old host checking logic previously accepted entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (see removed `SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host?` which parsed via `URI(h).host`). After the change, lookup uses `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, which extracts `uri.host` (e.g., `example.com`) and queries `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`. If the migration inserted raw values containing scheme/path/whitespace, they will not match the normalized host and embedding will break once the old settings are deleted (`execute "DELETE ... ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')"`).
